noGameBanner.message: This collection has no game assigned, so there are no card fields to build bin rules from. Recreate the collection and select a game to enable sorting.

binConfigPanel.disabledDescription: Cards never go here. They move on to the next bin that matches, or the catch-all.
binConfigPanel.disabledNotice: This bin is disabled. Its rules are kept, but no cards are sent to it until you turn it back on.
binConfigPanel.overrideDescription: When these rules match, this bin takes priority over ordinary bins. If several override bins match, priority 1 wins over 2, and so on. Override bins on the same priority send the card to whichever is emptiest. For example, use Price ≥ 1 here to override color bins for cards worth $1 or more.
binConfigPanel.maxCopiesDescription: Once this bin holds this many copies of the same printing (since it was last emptied), further copies skip it and go to the next bin whose rules match, or the catch-all.
binConfigPanel.needCatchAllError: At least one bin must be catch-all.
binConfigPanel.catchAllDescription: Cards that don't match any other bin will go here.
binConfigPanel.lowMatchDescription: Scans below this match percent come here even when another bin's rules match them, override bins included.
binConfigPanel.autoAssignWaiting: Waiting for a new {{field}} to appear
binConfigPanel.scanOnlyLocked: Scan Only is on — every card routes straight to bin 7. Turn it off above to configure bins.
binConfigPanel.modeChangePending: Save or discard the pending mode change above before editing bins.
binConfigPanel.priorityDescription: 1 is the highest priority. When several overrides match a card, the lowest number wins, and overrides on the same level send it to the emptiest of their bins. Overrides without a level come last, in bin order.
binConfigPanel.priorityOrder: Overrides are checked in this order: {{order}}
binConfigPanel.catchAllRulesDescription: Cards matching these rules come here even when another bin's rules match them, like a color card that snuck into a colorless pile. Leave empty to only catch cards no other bin takes.

binList.needCatchAll: One bin must be set as catch-all.

presetSelector.deleteSetDescription: Deletes "{{name}}". Contact support if you need it back.
presetSelector.revertSuccess: Reverted to previous bin set state
presetSelector.renameSetDescription: Enter a new name for this set.
presetSelector.newSetDescription: Create a new set with 7 empty bins.

autoAssignPanel.heading: Auto-detect sorting
autoAssignPanel.description: Learns bin assignments as you scan: the first time a new value appears for the field below, it claims the next open bin. Repeats route back automatically, and once every bin is taken, new values fall to the catch-all.
autoAssignPanel.resetConfirmDescription: Clears every bin's learned value in this set. New scans will refill them from scratch.

scanOnlyPanel.heading: Scan only
scanOnlyPanel.description: Sends every card straight to bin 7, the catch-all, without checking any sorting rules. Turn this off to configure bins manually.

repackPanel.heading: Build repacks
repackPanel.description: Every non-catch-all bin builds its own pack at the same time from the slots you define below (e.g. 3 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare). Anything that doesn't fit an open slot in any bin goes to the catch-all. Once a bin's pack is complete it stops receiving cards - empty it to start a new pack there while the others keep filling.
repackPanel.allowDuplicatesDescription: When off, a card already in a given pack is skipped for that bin (it can still start a different pack that doesn't have it yet) instead of being added again.
repackPanel.siftDescription: Cards that match the rules below go to the first bin instead of a pack, so you can pull out cards you want to keep (by value, rarity, set or anything else) while every other bin builds packs from the rest.
repackPanel.siftHint: Cards matching these rules go to bin {{bin}}. Every other bin builds packs from the rest.
repackPanel.siftNoBin: Sifting needs at least one enabled bin besides the catch-all.

chaosPanel.heading: Chaos sort
chaosPanel.businessOnly: Chaos sort is part of the Business plan.
chaosPanel.description: Ignores the rules and fills the bins one after another, moving on when a bin is full. When you empty a bin, pick the storage location you put it in, and every card is recorded there in order.
chaosPanel.binSizeDescription: Moves to the next bin after this many cards. Leave empty to fill each bin to its calibrated size.

alphabetPanel.heading: Sort alphabetically
alphabetPanel.description: Sorts by the first letter of each card's name, one letter per bin. With 8 sorting bins, the first pass sorts A to H and sends everything else to the catch-all. Empty the bins, put the catch-all cards back in the feeder, and move to the next letters until the alphabet is done. To go further, use Sort deeper on any pile to sort it by its next letter (AA, AB, AC…).
alphabetPanel.needBins: Alphabetical sort needs at least one bin besides the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.prefixRange: Sorting the {{prefix}} pile by its next letter: {{from}} to {{to}}. Everything else goes to the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.passRange: Sorting names starting with {{from}} to {{to}}. Everything else goes to the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.nextPassHint: When this pass is done, take the cards out of every bin, put the catch-all cards back in the feeder, then move to the next letters.
alphabetPanel.lastPassHint: This is the last pass. Anything left in the catch-all afterwards has a name that doesn't start with a letter.
alphabetPanel.confirmTitle: Move to a new set of letters?
alphabetPanel.confirmDescription: Make sure every bin is empty and the catch-all cards are back in the feeder. All bins will be marked as emptied.
alphabetPanel.nextPileHint: When this pass is done, take the cards out of every bin and keep each pile in order. Next up: the {{prefix}} pile.
alphabetPanel.confirmPileDescription: Empty every bin, keeping each pile in order, then put the {{prefix}} pile in the feeder. All bins will be marked as emptied.
alphabetPanel.pileDoneHint: This is the last pass for the {{prefix}} pile. Start over to go back to the whole alphabet.
